summary: Bulloch County tower named airport, listed at 175 ft about 0.6 km from Statesboro-Bulloch County Airport; no source we found describes its build, staffing or fate.

evidence.supports: Statewide list has one entry named airport in Bulloch County, elevation 175 ft (53 m)
Forest Lookouts page under the same name and county
Published coordinates of Statesboro-Bulloch County Airport
State forestry air unit began in Statesboro in May 1958
evidence.quote: The Air Operations Unit of the Georgia Forestry Commission began its operation in Statesboro in May of 1958

evidence.supports: Air unit worked out of a hangar at the airport
evidence.quote: worked out of the present-day hangar

notes_for_editor: Only two sources name this tower: the tnlandforms statewide list (name, county, 175 ft, coordinates) and the Forest Lookouts index (name and county). Two web searches, the cached NHLR Georgia index (29 registered towers, this one not among them) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Georgia chapter PDFs (2012, 2013, 2023) found nothing on its build, staffing or fate. The 0.6 km offset from the airport's Wikipedia point is our calculation from the two coordinate pairs, not a source's. The forestry air-unit paragraph is context only; none of the sources ties the unit to a tower. The record's GFC US 121 register number matches the list's gfc-121 reference but was not checked against GFC records. Ask the Georgia Forestry Commission property or records office, or the Statesboro airport office, whether a tower stood on the field, and when it came down.
